content:
maria-partnerships: Quick kickoff — Saturn Satellite region provisioning with NebulaCloud + SI. Goal: provision dedicated capacity, KMS entitlements, and lock press embargo. Tentative go-live 2025-06-10. Need owners for quotas, legal signoff, and launch comms. @raj-eng-ops @sophie-legal please.

raj-eng-ops: ack. Can you share target capacity / GPU SKUs? I need numbers for quota requests and possible burst pool sizing.

maria-partnerships: Initial ask: 8x A100-80GB equiv for Dedicated pools (steady), burst to 16 for first 72h. Also 4x CPU-heavy nodes for control plane. Partner asked for reserved IP space and VPC peering window.

oliver-sre: noted. For A100-80GB equiv please give preferred instance family name (Nebula uses `nc-a100x`), and preferred AZs. We should also pre-authorize fallback to q4-8 quantized variants if capacity constrained.

sophie-legal: quick Q on data residency: will customer data stay in Saturn region (partner-managed storage) or flow through Redwood control plane? Need details for DPA + SOC checklist.

maria-partnerships: Customers for launch must keep data region-local; partner proposed customer-managed storage and KMS in their tenant. Redwood control plane will be in EU-central as control-only, no token logging. Will confirm in writing with Nebula.

kevin-product: For announcement/embargo — product wants a joint blog + one-pager. Can we confirm embargo end date? Also need a short list of reference customers (optional).

clare-success: onboarding checklist: SI will run 2 integration sprints with customers. Need to align customer onboarding calendar with capacity ramp. Will draft sync call invite after we settle quotas.

deploy-bot: quota-request created: QID 2025-SS-045. Status: pending partner approval.

raj-eng-ops: I'll file quota requests once we lock SKU/AZ. Draft for Nebula API call (for ops):

``` 
POST /nebula/v1/quota
{
  "region":"saturn-sat-1",
  "sku":"nc-a100x",
  "count":8,
  "burst":16
}
```

maria-partnerships: Alan (Nebula PM) confirmed AZs sat1-a/b and sat1-c for fallbacks. He also requested KMS flow details: who holds CMKs and how access is provisioned.

sophie-legal: If partner holds CMKs we need key escrow and audit plan. Please route Nebula's KMS whitepaper to me and include key rotation policy. Also require written indemnity for cross-border exports if any.

oliver-sre: Ops note — need to add the Saturn region to our routing policy: prefer local region, fallback to eu-central read-only cache. Also add rollout policy: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h. Config snippet for rollout:

```
rollout:
  - canary: 0.05
  - stage1: 0.25
  - full: 1.0
  - window_hours: 48
```

kevin-product: For customer-facing perf numbers we need SLOs: 99th p95 latency target and cost per token estimate for dedicated vs hosted. Ops — can we get bench numbers on nc-a100x baseline?

raj-eng-ops: I'll run a short benchmark and paste results here by EOD tomorrow. Likely p95 single-request ~120-200ms depending on prompt length.

maria-partnerships: Action items: (1) @raj-eng-ops: file quota request with exact SKU/AZ + attach burst policy (QID 2025-SS-045), (2) @sophie-legal: review Nebula KMS doc & DPA, (3) @clare-success: draft customer onboarding weekmap, (4) @kevin-product: draft launch asset list and embargo timeline. I'll follow up with Alan for written confirmation of CMK approach.

clare-success: I'll schedule kickoff call with SI + 2 pilot customers for next Tue. Will include runbook and acceptance criteria.

sophie-legal: FYI — will need 3 business days for DPA redline once I get Nebula docs.

maria-partnerships: Great — let's try to keep the next sync light. If anyone blocks on approvals drop here. :eyes:

oliver-sre: flagged one potential risk: Nebula's default autoscaler uses spot-like preemptibles for burst. Need explicit SLA if we rely on burst for the first 72h. Ops to confirm alternatives.

raj-eng-ops: noted, adding a pinned note to QID 2025-SS-045 about reserved capacity only for the first 72h.

kevin-product: tagging comms: embargo lift set to 2025-06-10 17:00 UTC tentatively. Product will coordinate final date after legal signoff.

maria-partnerships: thanks everyone. I'll post a short summary and update the partnership playbook doc after today's sync. Alan from Nebula will join tomorrow's call at 16:00 UTC.
